name: Innistrad
description: Innistrad is a gothic plane where humanity is prey to werewolves, vampires, zombies, geists, demons and other horrors once the moon rises, and it is Sorin Markov's home plane.

summary.text: Innistrad is a gothic plane where humanity is prey to werewolves, vampires, zombies, geists, demons and other horrors once the moon rises, and it is Sorin Markov's home plane.

bio.text: Sorin lorded over Innistrad for millennia, preserving the balance between humanity and the monsters that prey on it.
When Avacyn, its protector, was lost, Tamiyo warned that the plane had lost its protector and the world shook, and madness swept the plane.
Nahiri swore that Innistrad would bleed as Zendikar had, after which its final ward fell and she called Emrakul to the plane.
Nahiri then left the plane, with Sorin trapped, and Emrakul was bound and sealed in the moon of Innistrad.
Later, with the key gone and the Celestus silent, night settled on Innistrad for eternity.
More recently the Theorist sent Tam through an Omenpath to record Innistrad's planar data.

status.text: As of the latest events recorded, Innistrad lies in permanent night with Emrakul sealed in its moon.

timeline.summary: The journal reveals vampires were created by humans: Markov and the demon Shilgengar used an angel's blood, after trapping and draining Marycz.
timeline.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

timeline.summary: The journal says Sorin created Avacyn to hold the vampires in check and that the church keeps humans as livestock, never able to defeat them; Dovid concludes his faith is a lie.
timeline.quote: We are livestock. We are unwitting participants in our own cultivation.

timeline.summary: Sigarda recalls how, a thousand years ago, Avacyn destroyed their heretic sister and her entire flight after the sister allied with a demon lord.
timeline.quote: Avacyn single-handedly destroyed their sister and her entire small flight

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls her one meeting with Sorin long ago, when he tested and dismissed her and warned her to be a civil guest (recounted).
timeline.quote: He sought me out, tested my strength in battle, and pronounced me too weak to be a threat.

timeline.summary: Journal entry 433: the author dissects a large werewolf specimen sent by Jenrik.
timeline.quote: With great effort, the rib cage was separated, the specimen split from clavicle to pelvis, its contents exposed to air.

timeline.summary: The author finds the specimen's interior filled with sinew and almost nothing human, with a large cluster growing on the liver.
timeline.quote: This one, though. This one was...new.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin, still weakened from creating Avacyn, is pulled from his restoration by the arrival of another planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Something had pulled him prematurely from his restoration.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Sorin knew her immediately.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement; Sorin dismisses her, recalling that he took her under his wing.
timeline.quote: When your Planeswalker spark first ignited, it was I who discovered you.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri raises a field of floating stones, forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Avacyn tears through the clouds and crashes into Nahiri to protect Innistrad.
timeline.quote: the archangel who came barreling into her with enough force to carry both figures off the stone column.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri overpowers Avacyn with her sword, driving her back.
timeline.quote: Soon, Avacyn was in retreat.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin blocks Nahiri's sword, disarms her and holds a blade to her throat, ending the fight.
timeline.quote: Sorin brought the point of his blade up to her throat.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says she is here only to understand and chronicle, and expects the plane to be doomed.
timeline.quote: I am not here to fix this world's problem. I am here to understand it.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo warns of consequences and says the plane has lost its protector as the world shakes.
timeline.quote: The plane has lost its protector

timeline.summary: On another world Arlinn lives as a werewolf with a human mind and learns that she must trust herself to be whole.
timeline.quote: She had to trust herself to be whole.

timeline.summary: Nahiri arrives on a bluff on Innistrad and finds the Helvault instead of Sorin.
timeline.quote: On the highest part of the bluff, where she had sensed his presence, stood instead a massive, rough-hewn chunk of silver

timeline.summary: Sorin appears behind Nahiri and she greets him joyfully.
timeline.quote: My friend!" she managed to say at last. "You're alive!

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Early in their acquaintance, Sorin broke Nahiri's arm in a lesson and told her she was no longer mortal.
timeline.quote: You broke my arm!

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement.
timeline.quote: You risked my plane, and more.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Nahiri he owes her nothing and that he molded her, telling her to bother Ugin instead.
timeline.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls up a granite column and swirling stone darts, declaring she is not going anywhere.
timeline.quote: She called forth a column of rock from the depths beneath them

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone column swallows Sorin and he breaks free in a burst of light.
timeline.quote: but the stone column simply swallowed him.

timeline.summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sinks into the earth to escape the light and reconsider.
timeline.quote: She dug her hands into the soil, extending her will not out, but down, and dove into the earth itself.

timeline.summary: Nahiri forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

timeline.summary: An angel crashes out of the sky and slams into Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Then everything went bright again, brighter than the moon, and a shape came screaming out of the heavens.

timeline.summary: Sorin stops Nahiri's sword with his own and explains the angel is the other half.
timeline.quote: The other half,

timeline.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
timeline.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

timeline.summary: A year ago, Nahiri lands in a cobblestone street in Thraben amid chaos as the angel rises in white light.
timeline.quote: Nahiri slammed into a surface on her hands and knees, her endless fall over at last.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds her body wounded and mortal-like, no longer an extension of her will.
timeline.quote: Her body was no longer an extension of her sense of self.

timeline.summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Innistrad's final ward falls and the plane is left naked and vulnerable.
timeline.quote: Innistrad's final ward had fallen.

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls to the sky for Emrakul to come to Innistrad as the plane trembles.
timeline.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

timeline.summary: Maeli, guarded by cathars, remembers fleeing his burning village as his mother ordered.
timeline.quote: He had run into the forest like his mother had told him, and he had not gone back to the village.

timeline.summary: Ms. Sadie's chest bursts open into many arms at dinner and she chases Maeli.
timeline.quote: the same writhing arms that had burst out of Ms. Sadie's chest that very night while they ate their dinner

timeline.summary: The cathars slice off Ms. Sadie's grasping arms.
timeline.quote: The cathars shifted in the tall grass, slicing off one arm after another.

timeline.summary: Maeli prays to Avacyn, who is dead, for help.
timeline.quote: PLEASE, AVACYN! HELP ME!

timeline.summary: A mad angel announces that Emrakul is rising and dives at Maeli.
timeline.quote: She dove down, her blade slicing through the air ahead of her.

timeline.summary: Bruna and Gisela are gone, becoming one fused angel that proclaims Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's angel parted four wings, reached out with two arms, and cried with a single voice that sprang from two mouths

timeline.summary: Emrakul's angel leads the faithful below in a chorus of We are Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's angel led all below in following Her radiant form.

timeline.summary: Jace, shielding his mind with Tamiyo's teaching, is distracted by the warped angel overhead.
timeline.quote: This time it had been the sight of the warped angel in the sky overhead that had distracted Jace.

timeline.summary: Jace recalls Gideon told him to return to Zendikar if he heard of a titan.
timeline.quote: Gideon himself had told Jace to come back to Zendikar if he heard news of the titan.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Emrakul for the first time, bigger than the others, with all of Innistrad following her.
timeline.quote: It was the first time he had actually seen Her: the titan, Emrakul.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Emrakul her name and is flooded with words of conquest.
timeline.quote: The beginning—I shall be all.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: It was time to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo refuses to come with Jace, saying that is not her path.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. That's not my path.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo shields Jace's mind so that he can planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: I will protect your mind so you can planeswalk

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin trapped.
timeline.quote: Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives on Innistrad, finds the sky tearing apart, and stands on a hill above burning Thraben.
timeline.quote: He could see the city now, and half of it was ablaze.

timeline.summary: Jace overloads the minds of three mad werewolves; two die and the third mutates into something unrecognizable.
timeline.quote: Whatever he had done had triggered some sort of reflexive mutation.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives and slays the mutated creature as it corners Jace.
timeline.quote: "It's fine, Jace. I've got your back."

timeline.summary: Chandra and Nissa arrive, and Jace lays out the plan: Nissa taps the leylines with her glyph, Gideon clears a path, and Chandra channels the energy.
timeline.quote: Nissa will use her planar glyph to tap into the leyline network.

timeline.summary: Nissa warns the plan will fail because the leylines have been redirected into the cryptolith network at Thraben, and after listening she agrees she can do it.
timeline.quote: "It's not going to work. The leylines have already been redirected. Into that."

timeline.summary: The woman in violet gives a cold answer, then pours drinks and toasts to new good old days to keep Jace there.
timeline.quote: To new good old days,

timeline.summary: Cathars burst into an inn with reports of a white witch, and Teferi joins them as an excuse to leave.
timeline.quote: cathars from the local church came charging into the inn with reports of a white witch seen in the woods

timeline.summary: With the key gone, the Celestus falls silent and night settles on Innistrad for eternity.
timeline.quote: It is night on Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Algli's husband and sons die in a ghoul attack on the family tannery, and she survives by setting the tannery aflame.
timeline.quote: Her husband and her youngest son threw themselves between her and the ghouls, and she set the tannery aflame.

timeline.summary: A ghoulcaller raises Algli's dead family; she meets Olutio and together they slay him, and Olutio first speaks to her of the Buried Lord.
timeline.quote: Standing over their fresh graves, Olutio first spoke to her of the Buried Lord.

timeline.summary: The three cultists perform the last ritual in the clearing with a goat, but nothing seems to happen.
timeline.quote: A goat, hooves and horns, in the image of a demon.

timeline.summary: Sruta calls Olutio and Algli fools and leaves, and Olutio follows, leaving Algli alone with her despair.
timeline.quote: "You were always a fool, Olutio," she said.

timeline.summary: Algli finds a wounded angel behind her who says she is compelled to answer the call and that the Buried Lord is hungry.
timeline.quote: "But the Buried Lord has never been one to protect. He is here, and he is hungry."

timeline.summary: Algli bandages Liesa's wound and tells her about the Travails and the fall of the angels.
timeline.quote: Algli bandaged the angel's ribs firmly

timeline.summary: Liesa introduces herself as an archangel who once led the Flight of Dusk and asks Algli to help her rebury the Buried Lord.
timeline.quote: "I am Liesa, archangel who once lead the Flight of Dusk.

timeline.summary: Liesa and Algli find Olutio's gutted body.
timeline.quote: They found the gutted remains of Olutio first

timeline.summary: The Buried Lord devours Sruta in front of them and greets Liesa as an old friend.
timeline.quote: On the last word his teeth sunk into Sruta, snuffing her screams with a gruesome tear.

timeline.summary: The Buried Lord offers Liesa an alliance if she hands over Algli, and she refuses.
timeline.quote: "Give me the third, and she will be my last."

timeline.summary: Liesa drives her spear into the Buried Lord's spine and he vanishes, but then he erupts from the ground and seizes Algli.
timeline.quote: Liesa drove the spear deep into the demon's spine.

timeline.summary: Algli chants the old rites and feeds the Buried Lord's strength; Liesa orders her to fall silent.
timeline.quote: As the cultist chanted, the darkness soaked into the demon.

timeline.summary: Algli offers her life and thrusts her torch into the Buried Lord's mouth, and Liesa channels the fire and hope through her spear to behead him.
timeline.quote: With both hands, Algli thrust her torch into the roof of the Buried Lord's gaping maw.

timeline.summary: Liesa beheads the Buried Lord, but his body does not crumble, and she feels they are still bound.
timeline.quote: Liesa yanked her spear free with a twist

timeline.summary: Algli offers to forge the Buried Lord's remains into Liesa's armor and to serve her; Liesa asks for an alliance instead and Algli swears to be her ally.
timeline.quote: "As I breathe and hope, my lady Liesa.

timeline.summary: In a flashback to six millennia earlier, Sorin tells his grandfather Edgar that vampires will drink Innistrad dry and Edgar dismisses it.
timeline.quote: "Sorin. Do you truly believe I've never had the same thought?"

timeline.summary: Sorin recalls that after six millennia he gave humans a protector, saving Innistrad, and reflects that defeat found him.
timeline.quote: Humans needed a protector. He gave them one.

timeline.summary: Strefan survives falling into Brandt's stake pit, fends off a thrown vial of blessed water and escapes.
timeline.quote: He screamed as he felt his exposed skin burn.

timeline.summary: Strefan hurls a stake and wounds Brandt, then chases him as he flees on horseback.
timeline.quote: Bloodlust rising, he rose into the air and rushed in pursuit.

timeline.summary: Strefan staggers out of the ruin, weak and starving, and fears he might die after all.
timeline.quote: perhaps I won't.

timeline.summary: The Theorist sends Tam to Innistrad through an Omenpath to record its planar data.
timeline.quote: "Go to Innistrad. I need its planar dimensions, including extraplanetary bodies.

timeline.summary: Tam measures Innistrad's dimensions and discovers she can briefly freeze a rat with her gaze without petrifying it.
timeline.quote: The rat does not move, but does not turn to stone.

timeline.summary: Tam reaches an inn and learns from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town.
timeline.quote: "My uncle died the day the town became the Town.

timeline.summary: Tam has her first beer, and Moiren tells her that suffering is the only constant and the church teaches death is rest.
timeline.quote: "The church teaches that death is the rest we are rewarded in the end.

timeline.summary: Three vampires attack the inn; Moiren fights them and Tam freezes them with her gaze so Moiren can behead them.
timeline.quote: Tam stares , and all three vampires freeze in place.

timeline.summary: Moiren tells Tam she is worth saving.
timeline.quote: "You're worth saving, Miss Tam."

timeline.summary: At night Tam reaches out telepathically, and the monster in the moon yanks her mind into a psychic prison.
timeline.quote: Something hears her and yanks her up.

timeline.summary: The monster speaks through an emaciated puppet woman, saying it eats time and hungers for her knowledge.
timeline.quote: I have eaten time , says the woman

timeline.summary: Tam braids the puppet's hair to appease it, and learns it eats planes.
timeline.quote: "You eat planes."

timeline.summary: The monster demands to be shown where Tam's Multiverse is and offers to rid her of it; Tam escapes.
timeline.quote: Run! Tam can't help the scream she lets out

timeline.summary: Emrakul allows the Gatewatch to seal her in the moon of Innistrad, waiting until the time is right.
timeline.quote: she willingly allowed the Gatewatch to seal her in the moon of Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Edgar's grandson Sorin betrays him by imprisoning him in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Edgar's own grandson Sorin, while in his human form, betrayed Edgar by creating and imprisoning him in the Helvault

timeline.summary: Avacyn imprisons her sisters in the Helvault with Edgar Markov and Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: She imprisoned them in the Helvault with the foul Edgar Markov and sinister Griselbrand, where they might contemplate their folly.

timeline.summary: Avacyn orders Odric to kill Thalia after she abandons the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Avacyn ordered Odric, Thalia's longtime comrade, to kill Thalia.

timeline.summary: Humans fight back with torch-wielding mobs, trained cathars, and the power of the Church of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: They train specialized holy warriors called cathars to strike back against the supernatural horrors.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand traps Avacyn in the Helvault with him, weakening the rites that invoked her and humanity's defenses.
timeline.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him

timeline.summary: Madness sweeps Innistrad as hope of Avacyn's protection turns to horror.
timeline.quote: Madness swept over Innistrad as the fleeting hope of Avacyn's angelic protection turned to horror.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov intervenes and unmakes Avacyn, his beloved creation, and the plane's last protections fall.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov finally intervened, unmaking his beloved creation.

timeline.summary: Sorin lords over Innistrad for millennia, preserving the balance between humanity and the monsters that prey on them.
timeline.quote: he lorded over his home plane of Innistrad for millennia, preserving the balance between humanity and the monsters who prey upon them.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, born human on Innistrad, explores fiendish magic out of fascination with pain and is transformed into a half-devil.
timeline.quote: his fascination with pain drove him to explore fiendish magic that ultimately transformed him into a half-devil.

He is my erstwhile ally, self-proclaimed lord of his home plane of Innistrad.

Avacyn has turned on her own flock.
relations.quote: Avacyn had turned on her own, had unleashed violence and cruelty that seemed to shock everyone besides Liliana.
put their massive foot down on the soil of Innistrad, deep within the Kessig forest

relations.note: Kessig is a region of Innistrad.
relations.quote: "The nights on Innistrad are getting longer, but that means no one's getting any rest.

relations.note: Lambholt lies in the farmlands carved from the Ulvenwald.
relations.quote: through the farmlands that brave souls had carved out from the Ulvenwald.

relations.note: The Kessig earth is soaked at the festival.
relations.quote: Is it blood or wine that soaks the Kessig earth?

relations.note: The manor is Sorin's home on Innistrad.
relations.quote: Sorin descends the steps of Markov Manor.

relations.note: Selhoff is on the edge of the world.
relations.quote: Selhoff is a city on the edge of the world

relations.note: A village on the Kessig-Stensia border.
relations.quote: The extra half day of travel along the Kessig-Stensia border

relations.note: She is sealed in the moon of Innistrad.
relations.quote: she willingly allowed the Gatewatch to seal her in the moon of Innistrad.

relations.note: He lorded over his home plane.
relations.quote: he lorded over his home plane of Innistrad for millennia
